title: Watersound Condo Gulf Views & Pool Access
meta_description: B312 Watersound Oasis: 3BR/3BA condo in a gated 30A community with gulf views, large balcony, heated pool, fitness center & beach access. Sleeps 8.
description_expanded: AboutHome Highlights: * Gulf Views * Large Gulf Facing Balcony * Overlooks Community Pool and Outdoor Fireplace * Community Heated Swimming Pool, Fitness Center, and Parks * Three Bicycles * Fully Stocked Kitchen * Open Concept Living Area * Backpack Beach Chairs, Wagon & Umbrella * Nearby Shopping, Dining, and Entertainment * Gated 30A Watersound Community Welcome to Watersound Oasis in The Crossings on Watersound Beach! This stunning condo offers luxurious coastal living and is the premier choice for Watersound Beach Rentals. As you enter, you are immediately greeted by breathtaking views of the Gulf of Mexico. Watersound Oasis is one of the few units that overlooks the pool and outdoor fireplace, offering endless water vistas from your balcony. Located on the third floor of the condo building of Watersound Beach, this three-bedroom, three-bath home sleeps up to 8 guests. Upon arriving, you'll step into your private sanctuary, where every detail has been meticulously crafted to provide comfort and style for your Gulf Coast getaways. At 1,980 square feet, this residence boasts a spacious layout perfect for entertaining friends and family or enjoying a peaceful escape. The open-concept gourmet kitchen is a chef's dream, featuring a wine cupboard, stainless steel appliances, and an oversized center island where friends and family can gather. The adjacent great room is elegantly appointed with hardwood flooring, wainscoting, and oversized windows that flood the space with natural light. From sipping morning coffee or enjoying evening cocktails, the expansive balcony provides the perfect setting for relaxation and entertainment—all with Gulf views to truly envelope your beachside getaway. With a family-style dining area overlooking the water, every meal feels like a special occasion. Retreat to the primary suite for ultimate relaxation. It features a sitting area, access to the Gulf-facing balcony, and a luxurious ensuite bathroom featuring travertine flooring, dual vanities, and a soaking tub, where you can unwind after a day at the beach. Plus, the bunk room offers endless opportunities for sleepovers and Gulf Coast adventures. And with an oversized laundry room, you'll have everything you need for convenience and comfort. Outside your door, you'll find an array of amenities to enhance your Gulf Coast Getaway in 30A. Take a dip in the heated swimming pool, visit the fitness center, or explore the nearby parks and natural beauty of Deer Lake State Park and South Walton's unique coastal dune lakes. With its prime location near boutique shopping, dining, and entertainment at The Hub and easy access to the sugar white sands of the Emerald Coast beaches, Watersound Oasis offers the perfect blend of luxury and convenience. Experience the Gulf Coast Getaway you've always dreamed of with FunVacay! Pets and smoking is not permitted in this property.
